# VSVersionInfo.py template for PyInstaller
#
# This file is automatically generated by PyInstaller when you use the --version-file
# option. It contains the version information for your executable. You should fill
# it out and then add it to your .spec file.
#
# In your .spec file, use the following line:
#
# exe = EXE(
#     ...
#     version='version.txt',
#     ...
# )
#
